title: Antisymmetry of real quadratic singular moduli
summary: We confirm a conjecture of Darmon--Vonk on the antisymmetry of real quadratic singular moduli. The proof relies on a careful analysis of rigid meromorphic cocycles à la Darmon--Gehrmann--Lipnowski for the orthogonal group of a quaternion algebra. Moreover, we prove the modularity of a generating series of Kudla--Millson divisors in the spirit of Gross--Kohnen--Zagier.
